title: AutonomousRunnerAuditLogEntry
description: Schema for one JSONL line in <repo>/.ai-runner-state/audit/<taskId>.audit.jsonl, written by autonomous-runner/src/audit.ts. This is a DELIBERATELY SEPARATE schema from shared/schemas/audit-schema.json — that one describes Claude Code hook events observed during an interactive session (event enum: Stop/PostToolUse/SubagentStop); this one describes an unattended Analyze->Plan->Execute->Validate->Fix loop's own lifecycle. Neither is a subset or superset of the other; a reader should never assume a line from one validates against the other's schema.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the entry was written

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema (autonomous-runner's own — unrelated to shared/schemas/audit-schema.json's schema_version)

taskId.description: The run's taskId — matches the .state.json file of the same name

additionalPropertiesNote: Deliberately permissive (unlike shared/schemas/audit-schema.json's additionalProperties:false) — each event above carries a different, event-specific payload (e.g. validate_result carries pass/buildPass/testPass/reviewPass/errors; loop_resume carries resumedFromPhase/startPhase/startIteration; phase_end/phase_start carry phase/iteration/costUsd/toolCalls/subagentInvocations). See autonomous-runner/src/loopController.ts and cli.ts for the exact fields each event writes. String field values are truncated to 500 characters and passed through secret redaction (autonomous-runner/src/safety.ts#redactSecrets, autonomous-runner/src/audit.ts#sanitize) before being written — never trust this log to contain complete tool inputs or any credential.
